a.title: Dog-walking business
a.stem: Nia charges a $5 sign-up fee and $8 for each walk.
parts: Write an equation for the total cost c of w walks.
Which variable is the independent variable? Explain.
w, the number of walks
Use your equation to find the cost of 7 walks.
A customer paid $85. How many walks did the customer get?
10 walks

a.title: Paint mixture
a.stem: A paint color uses 3 cups of blue paint for every 5 cups of white paint.
parts: What is the ratio of blue paint to the total amount of paint?
How many cups of white paint are needed with 12 cups of blue paint?
20 cups
What percent of the mixture is blue paint?
Ana wants 40 cups of the mixture in all. How many cups of blue paint does she need?
15 cups

b.title: Map of a park
b.stem: On a coordinate map of a park, each unit is 10 meters. The gate is at (−6, 4), the fountain is at (5, 4) and the playground is at (5, −3).
parts: How many meters is it from the gate to the fountain?
110 meters
How many meters is it from the fountain to the playground?
70 meters
A bench is at the reflection of the gate across the x-axis. What are its coordinates?
How many meters is the walk gate → fountain → playground?
180 meters

b.title: A storage box
b.stem: A storage box is a rectangular prism 2 1/2 feet long, 2 feet wide and 1 1/2 feet tall.
parts: What is the volume of the box?
7 1/2 cubic feet
What is the area of the bottom of the box?
5 square feet
What is the surface area of the box?
23 1/2 square feet
How many cubes with edges of 1/2 foot fill the box?
60 cubes
